integrity: The proof and checker use only stated finite-field algebra. The verification code is included and replays the formula by direct enumeration. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to 2x2 matrices over finite fields. Exhaustive checks cover q=2,3,4,5,7 only; the all-prime-power statement rests on the proof. The 2018 integral-domain paper already gives an existence characterization, so the claimed advance is the exact finite-field multiplicity law and census, not existence alone.
title: Exact nil-clean decomposition multiplicities in \(2\times2\) finite-field matrix rings
